title: Izwi Esihlabathini Sasendulo
intro: Phakathi kwezithunywa zokuqala zika-Allah, kwakukhona oyedwa ogama lakhe likhanya kafushane kodwa ngendlela enenjongo e-Quran. Lo muntu waphila isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuba kuthunyelwe abaprofethi abaningi abakhulu, futhi wayaziwa ngokuba neqiniso nokubekezela okungantengantengi. Indaba yabo imfushane kodwa ifa labo lihlala likhona emlandweni waphakade. Ungubani lo mphefumulo ohloniphekile?
clues: Ngingomunye wezithunywa zokuqala, okukhulunywe ngazo kafushane kodwa ngendlela enenjongo eQuran.
Ubuntu bami bachazwa ukuzibophezela okungapheli eqinisweni.
Ngikhunjulwa encwadini ka-Allah phakathi kwalabo ababeqinile futhi benesineke.
Amavesi ambalwa nje amafushane e-Quran alandisa indaba yami.
U-Allah wangidumisa ngendlela eyami eyingqayizivele, engahlanganyelwanga nabanye abaprofethi.
Ngakhuliswa ngesikhundla esiphakeme, udumo oluyingqayizivele kwiQuran.

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
